title: How I Build Using Litematica
description:
A lot of people ask me how to become a technical player, well the first step is to have the right tools. In this video I will give you a taste of what it is like to embrace the full power of the minecraft engineering toolset. And hopefully you can learn to master these tools and apply them to your own builds.
